ruleDefinitions.name: Potential WinAPI Calls Via PowerShell Scripts
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects use of WinAPI functions in PowerShell scripts Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*VirtualAlloc.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*OpenProcess.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*WriteProcessMemory.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*CreateRemoteThread.*")) OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*OpenProcessToken.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*LookupPrivilegeValue.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*AdjustTokenPrivileges.*")) OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*OpenProcessToken.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*DuplicateTokenEx.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*CloseHandle.*")) OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*WriteProcessMemory.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*VirtualAlloc.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ReadProcessMemory.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*VirtualFree.*")))
